THE STORY
Fourteen goals in two periods, then a third period where nobody scored at all.

Oathe opened it. We answered with three straight — Jennings, Leitch, De La Cuba — and from there
it was trading until the middle of the second, when Christopher Rhomberg scored twice in nineteen
seconds to make it 7-4 and the game stopped being close.

Jennings got his second, Zimmerman made it nine, and Oathe got one back with seventeen seconds left
in the period. Then forty-five minutes of hockey and no more goals.

9-5.
